content.comment_body: Hello! I'm attempting to install [product_name] but keep getting an error message. Does anyone know what I might be doing incorrectly? I can't find any useful info in the log file.
We can't assist without more details.
I've sent you the log file.
You sent me a jpg file, but I'm unable to download it. The error says the file isn't a jpg.
No, I still can't download it. Please compress the log file into a zip archive and attach it directly to a post in this thread.
It might be best to start a support request so that [company_name] can review your log file.

analysis.insight_summary: A user has trouble installing [product_name], encountering an unspecified error and finding that the log file lacks helpful details. Sharing diagnostic files is proving difficult, slowing down troubleshooting efforts.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates a straightforward installation process supported by clear error messages and log info. They also expect simple methods for sharing troubleshooting files with the community or technical support.
